Measured faceted hardware concept • millimetres • no mechanism mesh or clip authored
CONCEPT / NEEDS ACCEPTANCE
A
Closed + locked / full support remains
B
Empty + parked / lower bale access
C

End hardware / inside retained envelope
700 × 530 × 1500 retained. Ordinary support planes: 100 / 700.
Full padding: 628 × 458. Pan: 644 × 480. Guards: 10 high.
Upper stock rests on the complete locked pan before unloading.
Lower textile bale only: removable 80 mm insert; top at 580.
Upper stock unloads first. Fold only when the upper pan is empty.
Opaque back/end panels omitted for this hardware cutaway.
Ø8 hinge axis: X215 / Y690
Shaft top 694 = padding underside.
Keeps the full 6 mm pad intact.
Folded bounds:
15 mm above lifted lower top 630.
5 mm to wall rail; 17 mm to back panel.
Changed from the earlier Y695 proposal: 5 mm less parked lift clearance.
Sweep lower bound 640.76 → 60.76 above stored lower top 580.
HINGE / DRIVE — section along Z at X215, Y690
Pan end Z322; rail inner Z325.
3 mm end gap stays unchanged.
Ø16 × 20 geared drive in end rail,
Z325..345; Ø8 shaft bridges gap.
Opposite end: same recessed bearing + spring/damper envelope.
Fixed seats below ends: X−225..−185, Y650..670, |Z|300..325.
Ø6 closed pin: (X−215,Y685); Z tip 316 engaged / 326 retracted.
Parked pin: (X210,Y1120). Pin bodies remain inside end rails/panels.
0.25 s unlock → 1.00 s empty fold → 0.25 s secure park.
Pause freezes preparation + handling. No simultaneous fold/lift.
Automatic close + positive lock required before upper placement.
No hand control, new pickup clip, menu, purchase or resource cost.
CONCEPT ONLY • actual hardware, occupied clearance, torque/load and mechanism timing still require verification before acceptance.
